summary: Navitas Semiconductor Corp filed an 8-K on May 13, 2026, reporting entry into a Sales Agreement with Craig-Hallum Capital Group and UBS Securities on May 11 for an at-the-market offering of up to $125 million in Class A common stock. As of May 12, the company sold 6,529,666 shares yielding net proceeds of ~$122 million, fully exhausting the registered amount. This is a routine capital-raising ATM program, not a special situation. No strategic event, activist, or restructuring is involved. There are no deal terms as there is no acquisition or merger; the ATM offering has been completed.
